title: New mRNA Vaccine Shows Success in Major Skin Cancer Trial
subtitle: Researchers say a personalized treatment could help prevent melanoma from returning after surgery.

summary.en: Pharmaceutical companies Merck and Moderna have announced positive results from a large Phase 3 clinical trial for a new cancer vaccine. The treatment uses mRNA technology to help the immune system identify and attack cancer cells. It is designed for patients with high-risk melanoma who have already undergone surgery. While experts call the results a promising breakthrough, they note that the full data still needs to be reviewed. The companies hope this technology can eventually be used to treat other types of cancer.
summary.zh: 製藥公司默克與莫德納宣布，一項針對新型癌症疫苗的大規模第三期臨床試驗取得了正面成果。該療法運用信使核糖核酸技術，協助免疫系統辨識並攻擊癌細胞。此疫苗專為已接受手術的高風險黑色素瘤患者設計。儘管專家稱此結果為充滿希望的突破，但也指出完整數據仍有待審查。藥廠希望此技術未來能用於治療其他類型的癌症。

paragraphs.en: A new medical development has brought hope to patients fighting skin cancer. Pharmaceutical companies Merck and Moderna recently announced that a large-scale study, known as a Phase 3 trial, showed positive results for a new personalized vaccine. This vaccine is designed to stop melanoma—a serious type of skin cancer—from returning in patients who have already had surgery to remove their tumors.
paragraphs.zh: 一項新的醫學進展為對抗皮膚癌的患者帶來了希望。製藥公司默克（Merck）與莫德納（Moderna）近期宣布，一項被稱為第三期臨床試驗的大規模研究顯示，一種新型個人化疫苗取得了正面成果。該疫苗旨在防止黑色素瘤（一種嚴重的皮膚癌）在患者接受手術切除腫瘤後復發。

paragraphs.en: According to BBC Health, the vaccine, called Intismeran, is given to patients alongside an immunotherapy drug called Keytruda. Immunotherapy is a type of treatment that helps the body’s own immune system fight disease. The study involved more than 1,000 patients with high-risk melanoma. The results suggest that using the vaccine and the drug together significantly increased the time that patients remained cancer-free compared to using the drug alone. It also helped lower the risk of the cancer spreading to other parts of the body.
paragraphs.zh: 根據英國廣播公司健康頻道（BBC Health）報導，這種名為 Intismeran 的疫苗是與一種稱為吉舒達（Keytruda）的免疫療法藥物共同使用。免疫療法是一種協助人體自身免疫系統對抗疾病的治療方式。這項研究涵蓋了超過一千名高風險黑色素瘤患者。結果顯示，與單獨使用藥物相比，合併使用疫苗與藥物能顯著延長患者無癌生存的時間，並有助於降低癌症擴散至身體其他部位的風險。

paragraphs.en: This vaccine is unique because it is personalized. Scientists use mRNA technology, which was also used for some COVID-19 vaccines, to create a treatment specific to each patient. By taking a small part of a patient's tumor and studying its DNA, researchers can identify specific mutations—or changes in the cells—that make the cancer grow. The vaccine then teaches the immune system to recognize and destroy any remaining cancer cells that might still be in the body.
paragraphs.zh: 此疫苗的獨特之處在於其個人化特性。科學家運用曾用於部分新冠肺炎疫苗的信使核糖核酸（mRNA）技術，為每位患者量身打造專屬治療。研究人員透過採集患者腫瘤的一小部分並分析其去氧核糖核酸（DNA），能辨識出導致癌症生長的特定突變（即細胞內的變化）。隨後，疫苗會引導免疫系統辨識並摧毀體內可能殘留的癌細胞。

paragraphs.en: Dr. Robert Vonderheide, a cancer expert at Penn Medicine, explained to NPR that this approach is highly significant. He noted that the vaccine works by activating the immune system to create T cells, which are specialized cells that attack cancer. Because the treatment is designed for one patient at a time, it represents a new way to help people live longer with a lower chance of the disease coming back. Dr. Vonderheide also mentioned that this technology is already being studied for use in other types of cancer, such as lung, bladder, and kidney cancers.
paragraphs.zh: 賓州大學醫學院（Penn Medicine）的癌症專家羅伯特·馮德海德（Robert Vonderheide）博士向美國國家公共廣播電台（NPR）解釋，這種方法意義重大。他指出，疫苗的作用在於活化免疫系統以產生T細胞，這是一種專門攻擊癌細胞的特殊細胞。由於該療法是為每位患者個別設計的，它代表了一種能協助人們延長壽命並降低疾病復發機率的新途徑。馮德海德博士也提到，這項技術目前正被研究用於其他癌症，例如肺癌、膀胱癌與腎臟癌。

paragraphs.en: Despite the excitement, health experts are urging caution. While the companies have shared positive news, the full results of the study have not yet been released or checked by independent scientists, a process known as peer review. Dr. Talisia Quallo from Cancer Research UK told the BBC that while the research "shows promise," it is important to wait for the complete data to be fully reviewed. She emphasized that further funding is necessary to ensure that more patients can eventually access these personalized options.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管各界感到振奮，健康專家仍呼籲保持謹慎。雖然藥廠已分享了正面消息，但研究的完整結果尚未公布，也尚未經過獨立科學家的審查，即所謂的同儕審查程序。英國癌症研究協會（Cancer Research UK）的塔莉西亞·夸洛（Talisia Quallo）博士告訴英國廣播公司，雖然這項研究「展現了前景」，但等待完整數據經過全面審查至關重要。她強調，必須投入更多資金，以確保未來有更多患者能取得這些個人化治療選項。

paragraphs.en: There are also practical steps that must happen before this vaccine becomes a standard treatment. Even after the trial process is finished, the vaccine must be approved by government health regulators. Prof. Peter Johnson, a director at NHS England, described the development as an "important advance" and noted that the health service is already preparing to bring this type of treatment to patients in the future. However, he acknowledged that the process of getting a new medicine approved for public use takes time.
paragraphs.zh: 在疫苗成為標準治療之前，仍有許多實務步驟必須完成。即便試驗程序結束，疫苗仍須獲得政府衛生監管機構的核准。英國國家醫療保健服務（NHS England）的主管彼得·強森（Peter Johnson）教授形容這項發展為「重要的進步」，並指出醫療服務體系已在為未來將此類治療提供給患者做準備。然而，他也坦言，讓新藥通過公眾使用核准的程序需要時間。

paragraphs.en: For the medical community, 2026 is becoming a very important year for cancer research. According to STAT News, the success of this mRNA vaccine, combined with other recent breakthroughs in cancer drugs, marks one of the most significant periods in the history of cancer treatment. As the trial continues, researchers will keep following the patients to see the long-term impact on overall survival rates.
paragraphs.zh: 對醫學界而言，二〇二六年正成為癌症研究極為重要的一年。根據 STAT 新聞報導，這款信使核糖核酸疫苗的成功，加上近期其他癌症藥物的突破，標誌著癌症治療史上最重要的時期之一。隨著試驗持續進行，研究人員將持續追蹤患者，以觀察其對整體存活率的長期影響。

paragraphs.en: For now, both Merck and Moderna are celebrating the news, and their stock prices have risen following the announcement. While patients and doctors wait for the final data, the medical community remains optimistic. If the full results confirm the early findings, this personalized vaccine could change how doctors approach cancer treatment, moving toward a future where therapies are specifically tailored to the unique biology of every patient.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，默克與莫德納兩家公司正慶祝這項消息，其股價在宣布後也隨之上漲。在患者與醫師等待最終數據的同時，醫學界仍保持樂觀。若完整結果證實了初步發現，這款個人化疫苗將可能改變醫師處理癌症治療的方式，邁向一個治療方案能針對每位患者獨特生物特徵進行量身打造的未來。

quiz.question: According to the article, how does the new vaccine function to prevent the recurrence of melanoma?

options.A: It directly kills the tumor cells during the initial surgery.
options.B: It trains the immune system to identify and eliminate remaining cancer cells.
options.C: It replaces the need for immunotherapy drugs like Keytruda.
options.D: It changes the DNA of the patient to prevent future mutations.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，疫苗的作用是「teaches the immune system to recognize and destroy any remaining cancer cells」，即訓練免疫系統辨識並摧毀殘餘癌細胞。選項 A 錯誤，因為手術是分開的過程；選項 C 錯誤，因為文章提到疫苗是與藥物共同使用（alongside）；選項 D 錯誤，疫苗是針對腫瘤 DNA 進行分析，而非改變患者自身的 DNA。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the future availability of the Intismeran vaccine?

options.A: It will be immediately available to all cancer patients by 2026.
options.B: It is currently being distributed to hospitals across the UK.
options.C: It must undergo further regulatory scrutiny before it can be prescribed to the public.
options.D: It is unlikely to be approved because it has not yet been peer-reviewed.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第五段與第六段，儘管初步結果樂觀，但仍需經過「peer review」（同儕審查）以及政府監管機構（government health regulators）的核准。選項 A 錯誤，因為核准過程耗時；選項 B 錯誤，NHS 僅是「準備」未來引進；選項 D 過於武斷，文章僅指出目前尚未審查，並未斷言不會通過。

quiz.question: In the fourth paragraph, what does the word 'activating' mean in the context of the immune system?

options.A: Stimulating the immune system to become more active.
options.B: Replacing the immune system with artificial cells.
options.C: Moving the immune system to a different part of the body.
options.D: Recording the history of the immune system's past battles.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在此語境下，「activating」意指啟動或刺激免疫系統，使其開始運作以產生 T 細胞來對抗癌症。選項 B 錯誤，疫苗並非取代免疫系統；選項 C 錯誤，這不是物理上的移動；選項 D 錯誤，這與紀錄歷史無關。此詞彙在此處描述的是一種觸發機制，用以提升人體防禦能力。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of this article regarding the new mRNA vaccine?

options.A: Merck and Moderna have successfully cured all types of skin cancer.
options.B: The vaccine represents a promising but still developing medical advancement in personalized cancer treatment.
options.C: Government regulators are currently blocking the release of the vaccine due to safety concerns.
options.D: The vaccine is only effective for patients who have not yet had surgery.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。全文旨在報導這項疫苗的臨床試驗初步成功，並強調其「個人化」的醫療突破意義，同時提醒讀者需等待後續審查與核准。選項 A 過度誇大，僅限於黑色素瘤；選項 C 錯誤，監管機構並未「阻擋」，只是需要時間審核；選項 D 與文章第一段敘述矛盾，該疫苗正是為了手術後的患者設計。
